body:
extensions_carepyre.conf: inbound calls now Answer, Playback a consent announcement, MixMonitor to record, then fall to a real Voicemail(1000@carepyre) mailbox on no-answer instead of hanging up. New voicemail_carepyre.conf. Real, named gap: the consent announcement wav file does not exist yet, Playback fails silently until a real recording or TTS is added. Full feature map in CarePyre/docs/GOOGLE_VOICE_FEATURES_NORTHSTAR.md. PARENA commit 87d77db, MONOREPO commit 963033c.

⚓ ☃
title: CAREPYRE-9311: real voicemail + auto-recording on inbound calls
